# blendops-build (reference summary)

## Purpose
Build the planned scene in Blender step by step: units, shapes, modifiers, materials, lights, camera, preview, render or GLB export, with a JSON report per step.

Turn an approved scene plan into a real Blender scene through the ready runtime path, one small step at a time, with a JSON report after every step.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/blendops-build/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/blendops-build/contract.json` (`v2.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `runtime-and-execution` / `scene-build-execution`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- A plan is approved and the user wants it built in Blender.
- A build step failed and needs a fixed retry.

## Trigger cues
- "build the scene in Blender"
- "make it in Blender"
- "model this object"
- "add materials and lights"
- "set up the camera in Blender"
- "render a preview"
- "export the GLB from Blender"
- "the script failed in Blender"
- "which socket name does this Blender version use"

## When not to use
- the scene plan, camera, or lighting plan is not decided yet → delegate to `blendops-scene-plan` (`references/skills/blendops-scene-plan.md`; plan before building)
- no runtime path is ready or the user has not chosen one → delegate to `blendops-connect-blender` (`references/skills/blendops-connect-blender.md`; check readiness first)
- GLB size, triangle, or texture budget questions → delegate to `blendops-glb-budget` (`references/skills/blendops-glb-budget.md`; budgets are owned by blendops-glb-budget)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `locked_scene_plan` (`object`): Approved plan from blendops-scene-plan or blendops-product-shot: objects, sizes, materials, lights, camera, output
- `runtime_path` (`string`): Ready runtime path from blendops-connect-blender: Path 1, Path 2, or CLI fallback

### Optional inputs
- `blender_version` (`string`): Blender version from bpy.app.version; decides API names such as the EEVEE engine id
- `output_targets` (`array`): Absolute output paths for preview, render, or GLB files

### Primary outputs
- `pre_build_scene_check`
- `pre_mutation_backup_record`
- `per_step_json_reports`
- `version_specific_api_choices`
- `preview_output_record`
- `render_or_export_record`
- `plain_language_change_summary`

## Quick-start procedure
1. Confirm the plan is locked and `blendops-connect-blender` says the runtime is ready.
2. Tell the user in plain words what will change in their scene and which files will be written, and wait for their yes before the first change.
3. Read the Blender version and the current scene; save a backup copy of the `.blend` file.
4. Build in this order, one small step at a time: units, rough shapes, modifiers, materials, lights, camera, preview.
5. Hand the preview to `blendops-look-check` (numbers, several views, one fix per round). Make the final render or GLB export once the look passes, then hand that file to `blendops-final-check` for the full done criteria. On any failure, hand off to `blendops-fix-problems`.

## Handoff notes
- **[progression]** Preview exists; check sizes, framing and looks before the final output → `blendops-look-check` (`references/skills/blendops-look-check.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.status equals "Produced"; artifact.type equals "preview"]`
- **[progression]** Final render or GLB exists; check it against the done criteria → `blendops-final-check` (`references/skills/blendops-final-check.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.status equals "Produced"; artifact.type in ["render","glb"]]`
- **[conditional]** A build step failed or the output looks wrong → `blendops-fix-problems` (`references/skills/blendops-fix-problems.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.errorDetected equals true]`
- **[fallback]** Runtime is not ready for building → `blendops-connect-blender` (`references/skills/blendops-connect-blender.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.verifiedReady equals false]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** BlendOps runtime guidance uses **2 MCP execution paths plus a CLI fallback appendix** (see `docs/runtime-stack-strategy.md`):
- Does not install Blender, configure an MCP bridge, or own a runtime; it points to upstream paths only.
- Does not claim render, export, preview, or GLB results without evidence.
- Does not hand the user Python as the final interface.
